data.name: Naeemaat
data.gender_notes: Naeemaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-m' meaning 'to be soft, gentle, or kind'. In Islamic contexts, Naeemaat symbolizes the comfort and grace bestowed by Allah. The name Naeemaat carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, or comfort” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naeemaat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, or comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine comfort and grace from Allah
data.etymology: Naeemaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty, or comfort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naeemaat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
